FIRST STEP: your worktree lacks an earlier approved change. Before anything else run: git apply /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/affordance-l2-reject/reject.patch . It makes the spec treat HTTP 409 turns as rejected turns (rejected: true, state null, stopped_on_rejections after 3 in a row) and teaches analyseRun, aggregate and formatMarkdown about them. Keep all of that working. Then do the changes below on top of it. For reference only, a worker already wrote the changes below against the old base at /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/affordance-l2-unseen/unseen.patch; you may read it and reuse its code, but it will not apply cleanly, so write the result by hand into the three owned files and make sure the rejected-turn tests and the new tests all pass.

You are a code worker. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit, push or touch .git. You own exactly: frontend/e2e/blind-player.js, frontend/e2e/blind-player.test.js, frontend/e2e/blind-player.spec.js. Do NOT edit any other file; import from others, never change them. Tests are hermetic node:test with injected fakes; never call the live game, OpenAI or the network, and do NOT run blind-player.spec.js (it spends a billed budget).

BACKGROUND: the L2 blind-player test has a model write one command per turn while seeing only what the screen shows. A live run showed two faults. (A) analyseRun never counts the opening text, so a thing the opening names (for example a drawer in the first paragraph) is reported as first shown on turn 1 and misses the 'shown by deadline' rate wrongly. The opening is turn 0, as in affordances.js measureScene (read it and match its deadline rule: turn 0 or turn 1). (B) Nothing checks that the player only refers to things the narration has actually shown.

FIX A: analyseRun takes a new optional field openingText (string). Treat it as turn 0 text when working out each affordance's first_shown_turn, silent_transition and the deadline. In blind-player.spec.js, capture the opening as the narration the player read before the first command: for scene 1A and any scene reached by walkScenes, use the opening text that scene-walk/affordances already expose (onOpening gives {scene_id, text}); for 1A when no walker is used, read the first .entry-output element's text from the DOM before the first command (the same way scene-walk.js does it; read that file). Pass it as openingText. Also store it in the replicate result as opening_text.

FIX B: add and export from blind-player.js unseenTerms({command, readText}) returning the content words of the command that do NOT occur as whole words in readText. Normalise with the same normalizeText as affordances.js (curly quotes, case, whitespace). Content words are letters only, 3 or more letters, after removing possessive 's, and not in a fixed stop list of determiners, pronouns and generic verbs that belong to the input grammar (the, a, an, my, of, for, in, on, to, and, with, from, at, it, its, this, that, search, examine, inspect, read, open, take, pull, look, check, use, go, walk, talk, ask, question, investigate, clues, around, into, out, up, down, off, over). Tolerate a plain plural or singular (drawer matches drawers) and a trailing -ed/-ing is NOT tolerated. IMPORTANT: readText must be the narration the player read: the opening text plus the text of every earlier SUCCESSFUL turn (turn.text from the segments), never the DOM transcript, because the DOM transcript also holds the player's own typed commands, and a word the player typed earlier would then look as if it had been shown. Rejected turns (rejected: true) add no read text. In analyseRun, compute for each non-rejected and rejected turn unseen_terms from openingText plus the text of earlier non-rejected turns, report unseen_commands: [{turn, input, unseen_terms}] for turns whose list is not empty, and unseen_command_count. In aggregate, report unseen_command_rate (unseen turns over all commands across replicates). formatMarkdown must list the unseen commands. Do NOT change askPlayer or playerPrompt, and do not tell the model about this check.

TESTS: add hermetic node tests for: opening-named affordance counted at turn 0 and deadline met; affordance named only on turn 3 not met; silent transition uses the opening; unseenTerms (word shown in opening, word only in the player's own earlier command counts as unseen, plural tolerance, possessive, stop words ignored, curly apostrophe); analyseRun unseen_commands including a rejected turn contributing no read text; aggregate unseen_command_rate; formatMarkdown lists unseen commands. Keep every existing test passing.

Run: cd frontend && node --test e2e/*.test.js (if frontend/node_modules is missing: ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/frontend/node_modules frontend/node_modules; never npm install). Write ./notes.md at the worktree root with what you changed and the exact stop list.
